findings.summary: _restoreAudioSession uses iosCategory 'soloAmbient' instead of 'ambient'. After hang-up, soloAmbient keeps other audio silenced for the session; ambient allows it to mix back in. Change to 'ambient'.
_restoreAudioSession uses interruptionModeIOS: 2 (DuckOthers) instead of 0 (MixWithOthers). Background audio that was playing before the call will not return to full volume. Change the literal to 0.

_finalCleanup does not call NativeCallKit.endCall(callId). All current termination paths call it upstream before reaching _finalCleanup, so no active bug today, but criterion 3 requires the call inside _finalCleanup. Add it guarded by session?.callId.
